cap_limits: Application tensor and context allocations bounded; Vulkan driver/pipeline global allocations cannot be hard-limited by public API and are not claimed measured. Small dimensions keep expected scratch allocations small; static/runtime size trace needed in admitted build.
backend: Only explicit Vulkan0 or Vulkan1 registry device; allow GPU/IGPU type, never CPU/ACCEL/META; no scheduler, backend_init_best or CPU graph.
reference: Independent double accumulation of actual float input values via deterministic formula; never a CPU ggml graph.
numeric_gate: Every finite output satisfies abs(actual-double_ref)<=atol+rtol*abs(double_ref); fixed before experiment, do not widen after failure. GPU accumulation order remains different from double reference.
corruption: --inject-corruption adds8 to last readback value in final case, leaving reference unchanged; must exit1 with last-case fail_count>=1. Control mutates host readback not execution, does not claim fault injection inside GPU.

exit_contract.0: All seven operator parity cases passed

fatal_behavior: Native abort/crash may bypass exceptions; wrapper must classify nonzero/partial JSON as failure or uncertainty, never PASS.
receipt_requirements: Full JSON must parse exactly once with duplicate keys rejected; exit0 agrees OPERATOR_PARITY_PASS and7cases
2048 outputs per case, finite_count2048, fail_count0, ownership and shape true
Selected exact registry/device and logs identify hardware; no4card/P2P/LLM qualification
Record command/environment/fresh compiled artifact hashes/exits/stdout/stderr/PID absence; do not count draft as tested
Backend supports_op and buffer identity are API checks, not independent residency or instruction tracing
execution_admission: Root review/build admission required; no commands executed by author
matrix_path_reason: Pinned ggml_vk_mul_mat routes ordinary F32 MUL_MAT with destination ne[1]=32 (>8) and batch2 to matrix helper, outside vector branches; dimensions far below hugeA split thresholds. Runtime trace still required to prove actual helper/pipeline used.
